a.xlink:title: Return the table's items in its own order, which is sorted by key.
Return each item's size factor, 1 where none was set.
Return the arrangement of these items, in this order.
Return one column name or several as a list.
Return a column's value for each item of the arrangement, in its order.
Return an `(items, features)` float array from one vector-valued column or several scalar ones.
Return the first `n` principal component scores, each signed so its largest loading is positive.
Arrange: group items by one column, or by several as a hierarchy, outermost first.
Arrange: give each item the features an assignment matches slots against, e.g. a mean color.
Arrange: keep only the items on the shortest path between two occurrences through their features.
Arrange: place each item by an angle in degrees and a radius, e.g. hue and chroma.
Arrange: place each item at a position read from columns, e.g. longitude and latitude.
Arrange: place each item by the first two principal components of its features.
Arrange: size each item in proportion to a column, its longest side standing for the value.
Arrange: order items by a column, ties kept in their earlier order.
Return the placed slots, one row per slot that received an item.
Return each distinct source in the order its first slot appears.
Assign: items to slots by the least total distance, each item used once.
Assign: the first item to the first slot, the second to the second, and so on.
Return a short digest of an array's shape, type and bytes.
Return an image given as an array or a path, as an array.
Return an image file's `(width, height)`, from the header alone for a PNG.
Return a cutout file as BGRA.
Render every item's cutout, rendering again those whose mask changed since; return their paths.
Write one image file per occurrence-part, after a chain of transforms.
Raise naming the closest matches if any column is missing from the frame.
Return a column name with `{part}` replaced by the item's part.
Return the filtered wide frame the collage's values come from, and the long rows behind it.
Return the cutout chain used when none is given: the frame cropped close to the mask.
Write one image of many specimens: cutouts arranged, laid out, assigned to slots and composed.
Return decorations as JSON-serializable data, an embedded image replaced by its digest.
Return the canvas: the under decorations, the cutouts in order, then the over decorations.
Return where every placement and decoration lands on a canvas fitted to `max_side`.
Return this decoration's drawing for these placements.
Return the slots for this arrangement.
Return the geometry, rounded, as JSON-serializable data: everything that decides the pixels.
Add a BGRA piece's alpha-weighted color into the `mean` accumulators.
Return the canvas and piece slices where a piece centered at `(cx, cy)` overlaps the canvas.
Return a uint8 mask of a centered hexagon (pointy-top, `size` across its flats) or circle.
Return `(left, top, right, bottom)` a decoration covers, in its own units.
Draw one decoration, in canvas pixels, onto a BGRA canvas in place.
Composite a BGRA piece over a BGRA canvas, in place, centered at `(cx, cy)`.
Return a line of text as a BGRA image about `height` pixels tall, on a transparent background.
Multiply a BGRA piece into a BGRA canvas, in place: darkening only, as overlapping inks do.
Return the width and height of a `width` x `height` box turned by `angle` degrees.
Return a decoration in canvas pixels.
Return a BGRA cutout scaled, flipped and turned, on a canvas just large enough to hold it.
Return a text decoration, in layout units.
Return `(left, top, right, bottom)` of the placed items' slots.
Decoration: a line of text centered above the collage.
Decoration: text under each item, from a column, or numbers in placing order.
Decoration: a bar under the collage showing how long `length` of the `scale_by` column is.
Decoration: a column of color squares beside each item, e.g. its palette.
Return the cutout with `pad` transparent pixels added on every side.
Return the cutout composited over a same-sized BGRA layer.
Effect: drain the cutout's color toward gray.
Effect: a solid outline around the cutout.
Effect: a drop shadow under the cutout.
Effect: blend the cutout's colors toward a color, by default its slot's (as `mosaic` sets).
Draw dashed reference lines at named positions.
Return a polyline decoration, in layout units.
Draw one line of small text at the top-left of an image, in place.
Return a blank figure with one axes, on an Agg canvas.
Return a figure of bars per category, or per group split by category.
Return a figure of counts through an ordered sequence of stages.
Return a figure of the distribution of one or more sets of values, overlaid.
Return a figure of one or more lines on shared axes.
Write a figure as a PNG, and return the path.
Return a figure with one point per pair of values.
Layout: each item at its own position, from `position`, `polar_position` or `project`.
Return a figure rendered as a uint8 BGR array.
Return a display-ready panel as 3-channel 8-bit BGR.
Return one fitted cell with its caption strip underneath.
Return a single line of text on its own strip.
Return one image centered in a fixed-size cell, scaled by one factor and letterboxed.
Return the grid with a title bar above it, if there is a title.
Return a grid with one row per item and one column per stage.
Return a grid of images, row by row, each captioned.
Return a slots frame at these positions, every other column at its default.
Return the distance between slot centers that keeps the largest item clear of its neighbors.
Return the vertical offset nearest the axis at which an item at `x` clears every placed item.
Return the position nearest the origin where a circle of radius `r` touches two placed ones and overlaps none.
Return the angle that turns an item's top outward (`radial`) or along the curve (`tangent`).
Return the center and diameter of what a set of placements covers.
Return pointy-top hexagonal lattice points, odd rows shifted right by half a pitch.
Return the arrangement of some items with their outermost group label removed.
Return the hexagonal lattice points with this step that land inside the mask, in pixels.
Return a decoration scaled about `(cx, cy)` by `factor` and moved to `(x, y)`.
Return `[(label, positions)]` for each outermost group, in order of first appearance.
Return the placed slots with `item` filled in, by the slots' own items or an assignment.
Return how many items fit around ring `ring`, one pitch apart.
Return a shape given as a mask, an image or a path, as a boolean mask.
Layout: items along one axis by their position, stacked outward from it where they would overlap.
Layout: items as the leaves of the tree their `group_by` hierarchy draws, with its edges.
Layout: one occurrence's parts at fixed offsets from each other, as an exploded diagram.
Layout: rows of slots, left to right and top to bottom.
Layout: a hexagonal lattice, each item optionally clipped to its hexagon so the tiles meet.
Layout: a specimen plate, slots in mirror-image pairs about a vertical axis, filled from the center.
Layout: a grid of slots, each carrying the mean color of its block of a target image.
Layout: each group laid out by `inner`, and the groups laid out by `outer`.
Layout: items as circles, sized by their scale, packed tightly around the center, largest first.
Layout: a sunflower disc, items placed at the golden angle, filled from the center outward.
Layout: concentric rings, each holding as many items as fit around it.
Layout: an Archimedean spiral outward from the center, items evenly spaced along it.
Layout: every item in one slot, one over another, as a ghost of their variation.
Layout: a hexagonal lattice clipped to a shape, filled from its center outward.
Write one panel, and record its path on `paths`.
Write one panel to `visualizations/<subdir>/<name>.png`, and return the path.
Return a boolean mask as a white-on-black BGR image.
Return the image with the mask's pixels tinted.
Return the panel a driver draws for one item: the mask over the image, captioned.
Return images stacked horizontally, the shorter ones padded with black at the bottom.
Write the main grid, the last checkpoint window and the sidecar.
Return how many items a `visualize=` argument asks for, or None when it names ids.
Return `(item, label, cells)` for the main grid, in display order.
Return `(sample, end)` for the checkpoint window starting at item position `start`.
Declare the items the activity will process, which fixes the sample.
Turn a `visualize=` argument into the ids to build a grid from.
Write what the main grid holds as `__<label>`, then empty it for the next round.
Write the main grid if anything new was collected, and return its path or None.
Take one display-ready panel for an item.
Mark an item finished, and write a checkpoint at a window boundary.
Write a whole-population figure as `__<name>.png`.
Return every item the report will want, or None if it may want any (rank mode).
Return `(row images, row labels)` of the main grid as it stands.
Return the report as a panel sink when it wants the item, else None.
Return whether a panel for this item would be kept.
Return the report for one activity, or a `NullReport` when `visualize` is off.
Return an occurrence column's value as the leading piece of a filename.
Return a segment's image with its mask as an alpha channel.
